35 [F153In section 11 of the M83Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 (evidence by certificate
as to driver, user or owner) the following subsection shall be inserted after
subsection (3)—
“(3A) Where the proceedings mentioned in subsection (1) above are proceedings
before a magistrates’ court inquiring into an offence as examining justices
this section shall have effect with the omission of—
(a) subsection (2), and
(b) in subsection (3), paragraph (b) and the word “or” immediately
preceding it.”]

S.I. 2013/1103, art. 4); S.I. 2013/1103, art. 2(1)(d)(2)(3) (with arts. 3, 4)
